text: Call Issued: July 31, 2018 Call Closed: September 14, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: Seven (7) Number of Bids: Three (3) Summary of Bids Received for Request for Proposal 9155-18-0309: Proponent Name 1 CIMA Canada Inc.
